```{r setup}
source("../shiny/R/logic.R")
d <- uat_load("../templates")
s <- uat_summary(d$tests, d$defects, d$trace)
g <- uat_gate(d$tests, d$defects, d$trace)
verdict     <- gsub("_", "\\\\_", g$verdict)
verdict_col <- if (g$go) "#43c47d" else "#e8657a"
```

```{=typst}
#let muted = rgb("#94a1c0")
#let panel = rgb("#222630")
#let card(body) = block(fill: panel, radius: 6pt, inset: 8pt, width: 100%, body)

#text(size: 15pt, weight: "bold")[IRT / RTSM User Acceptance Testing]
#parbreak()
#text(fill: muted, size: 8pt)[One-page guide · synthetic example · operational data only · human sign-off required]

#line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.5pt + rgb("#3a4157"))
#v(2pt)

#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), gutter: 8pt,
  card[
    == What UAT confirms
    Confirm the staging randomization and drug-supply build against the approved user requirements and specifications before real use. Execute positive, negative and boundary cases; retain dated evidence and an attributable execution record. The toolkit provides templates and a readiness screen for adaptation to the study.
  ],
  card[
    == The readiness screen
    The automated screen clears only when *all three* hold:
    #list(tight: true,
      [Every *Critical* test passes],
      [No open Critical/Major defects; closed defects pass retest; failing tests have a logged defect],
      [Every requirement names existing tests and every test has been run (Pass or Fail)],
    )
    Snapshot now: #text(fill: rgb("`r verdict_col`"), weight: "bold")[`r verdict`]. \
    #text(fill: muted, size: 8pt)[Open Minor defects need review or a documented waiver. A clear screen is not signed approval.]
  ],
)

#v(3pt)

#grid(columns: (0.9fr, 1.1fr), gutter: 8pt,
  card[
    == Bundled synthetic snapshot
    #table(columns: (1fr, auto), stroke: none, inset: 2.5pt,
      [Test scripts], text(fill: rgb("#e9edf7"))[*`r s$total`*],
      [Passed], text(fill: rgb("#43c47d"))[*`r s$pass`*],
      [Failed], text(fill: rgb("#e8657a"))[*`r s$fail`*],
      [Open defects], text(fill: rgb("#e0a64c"))[*`r s$open_def`*],
      [Requirements traced], text(fill: rgb("#3fd0c9"))[*`r s$cov`%*],
    )
    #text(fill: muted, size: 8pt)[Recomputed when this PDF is built; not a live tracker.]
  ],
  card[
    == Defect severity drives the gate
    #table(columns: (auto, 1fr, auto), stroke: none, inset: 2.5pt,
      text(fill: rgb("#e8657a"))[*Critical*], [Could break the blind, mis-randomize, mis-dose, or corrupt integrity], text(fill: rgb("#e8657a"))[Blocks],
      text(fill: rgb("#e0a64c"))[*Major*], [Significant functional error in a key workflow (resupply, wrong kit, missing alert)], text(fill: rgb("#e0a64c"))[Blocks],
      text(fill: muted)[*Minor*], [Cosmetic / non-functional (label typo, missing site number)], text(fill: rgb("#43c47d"))[Fix or waive],
    )
  ],
)

#v(3pt)

#card[
  == Where it runs: the systems (the workbook is the paper trail)
  *Staging IRT* (approved test list) #sym.arrow.r *browser execution* #sym.arrow.r *dated evidence* #sym.arrow.r *workbook* (tests, defects, traceability) #sym.arrow.r *signed package / eTMF*.
  #text(fill: muted, size: 8pt)[Failures also go to the *vendor defect tracker*; the vendor promotes a fixed build back to staging for retest. The workbook never connects to the IRT, you transcribe, on purpose.]
]

#v(3pt)

#grid(columns: (1fr, 1fr), gutter: 8pt,
  card[
    == Anatomy of an executable test (RAND-02)
    A good test has a *specific, verifiable* expected result, not "works correctly".
    #list(tight: true, spacing: 3pt,
      [*Precondition:* approved synthetic list loaded; the required stratum has an unused slot.],
      [*Steps:* register a synthetic participant, randomize, record kit and confirmation, then inspect the authorized allocation report.],
      [*Expected:* the next unused entry, arm and kit match the list; the investigator sees a *kit ID only*.],
      [*Verify:* every stratum and arm, plus permission failures and boundary cases.],
    )
  ],
  card[
    == The 8-step workflow
    #list(marker: none, tight: true, spacing: 3pt,
      [*1.* Derive test cases from URS + specs (positive · negative · boundary)],
      [*2.* Load the approved test list into staging IRT],
      [*3.* Execute each case in the browser; be systematic],
      [*4.* Record result + dated screenshot evidence],
      [*5.* Log every failure as a defect with a severity],
      [*6.* Vendor fixes; retest the new build],
      [*7.* Check actual test links, execution and retest evidence],
      [*8.* Evaluate the gate; a named human signs it into the eTMF],
    )
  ],
)

#v(3pt)

#card[
  == Run the interactive tool
  From the repository root: #raw("Rscript launch_app.R uat --install", lang: "sh")
  #parbreak()
  #text(fill: muted, size: 8pt)[The local app recomputes the screen as tests and defects change. CSV download contains the test table only; retain defects, traceability and signed evidence separately. Adapt and verify the toolkit before study-specific use.]
]
```
